From reference to model

A steam train in three pieces

The locomotive, its coal tender and a passenger car were each modeled from reference images of a rail-car set, then placed on a desert line outside the Maxon City Train Depot.

Reference images from the "Rail Cars" 3D model listing on TurboSquid. Shown for non-commercial, educational study only. All rights belong to the model's creator.
